title: Kenya Red Cross Deploys; CAR Border Surveillance Gaps Raise Regional Spread Concerns
detail: Kenya Red Cross deployed teams to support the response to Kenya's first confirmed Ebola case (Bundibugyo strain, imported from DRC), as regional health authorities flagged surveillance gaps along the Central African Republic's border with DRC that could enable further undetected spread. The deployment marks Kenya's first national Red Cross Ebola response activation.
